name: generated_stories_diagnostics_v2

llama_timeout.factor: client deadline 600 -> 1200 seconds; identical application request body
llama_timeout.hypothesis: A longer bounded wait permits this slow rewrite to return a complete response.
llama_timeout.support: Complete response received after 600 but before 1200 seconds; structural validity reported separately.
llama_timeout.weaken: Timeout at 1200 seconds or another execution failure. Completion before 600 is inconclusive about the increased deadline.

mistral_schema.factor: request format json -> required-field JSON schema; prompt and all other request fields unchanged
mistral_schema.hypothesis: Requiring the existing output fields in the decoding schema prevents explanation omission.
mistral_schema.support: Complete structurally valid response containing nonempty explanation; content quality remains unverified.
mistral_schema.weaken: Missing/empty explanation or other structure failure. HTTP schema rejection or timeout is an execution limitation, not evidence of story quality.

procedure_revision: Runtime revision 0.40.1 to 0.40.2; historical comparison confounded by runtime; same two cases and one-start budgets; no additional controls scheduled
